question: ¿En cuántos ensayos de leucemia se prueba algún fármaco que actúa sobre BTK?

attempts.query:
WITH tgt AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT md.parent_chembl_id AS pid
  FROM chembl.drug_mechanism dm
  JOIN chembl.target_components tc ON tc.target_chembl_id = dm.target_chembl_id
  JOIN chembl.molecule_dictionary md ON md.chembl_id = dm.chembl_id
  WHERE tc.gene_symbol = 'BTK'
), names AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT lower(m.pref_name) AS n FROM tgt h JOIN chembl.molecule_dictionary m ON m.parent_chembl_id = h.pid WHERE m.pref_name IS NOT NULL
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT lower(s.synonyms) FROM tgt h JOIN chembl.molecule_dictionary m ON m.parent_chembl_id = h.pid JOIN chembl.molecule_synonyms s ON s.chembl_id = m.chembl_id
), trials AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT nct_id FROM aact.browse_conditions WHERE downcase_mesh_term = 'leukemia'
), tn AS (
  SELECT i.nct_id, lower(i.name) AS n FROM aact.interventions i JOIN trials t ON t.nct_id = i.nct_id
  UNION
  SELECT o.nct_id, lower(o.name) FROM aact.intervention_other_names o JOIN trials t ON t.nct_id = o.nct_id
), matched AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.n FROM (SELECT DISTINCT n FROM tn) d JOIN names x ON length(x.n) >= 4 AND position(x.n IN d.n) > 0
)
SELECT count(DISTINCT tn.nct_id) FROM tn JOIN matched m ON m.n = tn.n
